release_gate.stage_b: Reproduce Xie et al. 2023 Figure 11 post-fill vaporisation-rate observations using the published penetration-theory closure.
release_gate.stage_c: Calibrate one surface coefficient on Dienhart Trials 3 and 5, freeze it, and assess radius on held-out Trials 4 and 6 plus the reported continuous-film video bands.

xie_2023.observable: Figure 11 evaporation velocity versus post-fill time
xie_2023.input_recovery: the separate red prediction curve is fitted only to recover its unreported thermal-age offset and initial substrate temperature
xie_2023.excluded: Figure 9 mass integration because Figures 9 and 11 are different runs/clocks and the linking initial temperature is not published
xie_2023.gate: 9 points; reproduced mean and maximum relative errors each within 0.02 absolute of the published values; published red-curve RMSE <= 6e-6 m/s

dienhart_1995.observables: Figures 5.24 and 5.25 discrete front radii and continuous-film video bands
dienhart_1995.gate: held-out RMSE <= 0.15 m for each surface and 10-60 s video-band coverage >= 0.90

preslhy.role: conditional stress diagnostic; not a v0.2 release gate because a measured inlet history is unavailable and repeated fills are correlated
preslhy.Concrete03_window_rule: 30 seconds after rule-based fill peaks; conditional post-fill assumption
preslhy.clock_correction: temperature is interpolated from X_Value onto Sync.Time; scale mass remains on Orig.Time

redistribution: Source PDFs and workbooks remain external. Generated derived comparisons are local ignored outputs.
